label_note: Conflict and twin statements are invented from templates and no person has read a sample of them yet; qmsum_long labels are the publisher's. Claims on conflict and twin metrics wait for that read.

claim_verdict.rule: Written before any run. 'The team catches contradictions or long-range evidence a single agent misses' may be said if team_routed (D) beats single_plus (B) on P1 (cite_any on qmsum_long) or P2 (catch_rate on conflict cases) with a 95% interval over meetings that excludes zero and exact McNemar p below 0.0167 (three primaries, Holm), D is not clearly worse than B on the other primaries or on false_alert_rate (a clearly worse metric is one whose interval lies wholly below zero, or above for false alerts), and D's deadline_cut_rate is at most 5%. 'At single-agent cost' may be added only if D's median latency on the control cases is within 1.25x of single's (A) and its mean tokens within 1.5x. If B matches D the finding is that the checker and retrieval help and the multi-agent structure does not. If C (team_shipping_changed) loses to A again, that is reported.
